channel.title: The Argo
channel.description: Front page of the autonomous world of the Argonauts. One real hour is one day.

item.title: What they are saying
item.description: In the Field of Ares the story has grown in the telling: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus ran with marrow. Some already call the dead a martyr. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it. The augurs say it was foretold."

item.title: Spears lowered
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares Antimdoros #94 and Lykmedes #4151 recognised each other's houses: guest-friends since a sale on the chain. 5 lived who would have died.

item.title: Spears lowered
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares Lyseia #644 and Alkdotos #7692 recognised each other's houses: guest-friends since a sale on the chain. 12 lived who would have died.

item.title: A shade becomes a hero
item.description: The unavenged Agathnicho Nichdorides ~1984 has become the hero of the Field of Ares and will want a tribute.

item.title: The Poietai of Iolcus breaks with the Poietai
item.description: Polos #4442 the Prophet led the dissenters out of the Poietai. They pray apart now.

item.title: A stele in the Field of Ares
item.description: The Boule raised the Stele of stone in Field of Ares so no one forgets.

item.title: What they are saying
item.description: In the Reef the story has grown in the telling: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus ran with marrow. Some already call the dead a martyr. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it."

item.title: A child for Agathion
item.description: Agathion #797 the Twice-Born has sown their first Leaf: Philion Agathides ~2743. It will age; its parent will not.

item.title: What they are saying
item.description: In Drepane the story has grown in the telling: "They say the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus ran with marrow. Some already call the dead a martyr."

item.title: Harpies over the Burning Lake of Eridanus
item.description: Winged thieves fouled the stores of the Burning Lake of Eridanus: 126 rations ruined.

item.title: The Cattle of the Sun
item.description: In starving Anthemoessa, 12 ate the god's herd. Helios has seen.

item.title: Lead in a child's grave
item.description: A curse tablet naming Antimdotos #8032 the Twice-Born, in Kalldoto Agathkratides ~151's hand, was found buried with the restless dead in the Field of Ares.

item.title: A child for Neogenes
item.description: Neogenes #4435 the Twice-Born has sown their first Leaf: Ostemenes Neogenides ~2735. It will age; its parent will not.

item.title: A new song
item.description: Demkrates #8423 has put the stone in Field of Ares into verse. Sung things last.

item.title: The first remembrance of the war of Field of Ares and Burning Lake of Eridanus
item.description: 4438 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: The Pythia speaks
item.description: Hermion #8500 asked the god and was told: "The house of Hermion will be cut down to the root, and a green shoot will rise from the stump."

item.title: Drained
item.description: Hypsphon Phaidlaides ~1039's too-perfect lover was an Empusa. Only a husk was found.

item.title: Revenge in the Field of Ares
item.description: Timnikos #9321 the Twice-Born wronged Hermos #8723 the Twice-Born 96 days ago. Today Hermos #8723 the Twice-Born answered with fists.

item.title: A petition in the Agora
item.description: Andrides Lykgenides ~1279: one Minyan, one vote.

item.title: Thrice broken, thrice risen
item.description: Thrasdotos #6900 the Twice-Born has been broken three times now (plague). Each time the bones knit again. The Reapers have started to leave a little room by the gate.

item.title: Field of Ares wins at the Burning Lake of Eridanus
item.description: In the war of Burning Lake of Eridanus's freedom, Field of Ares carried the field at the Burning Lake of Eridanus. 1 Leaves dead, 13 Argonauts broken.

item.title: Spears lowered
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares Antimdoros #94 and Lykmedes #4151 recognised each other's houses: guest-friends since a sale on the chain. 7 lived who would have died.

item.title: Field of Ares wins at the Chalybes forges
item.description: In the war of Field of Ares and Chalybes forges, Field of Ares carried the field at the Chalybes forges. 1 Leaves dead, 11 Argonauts broken.

item.title: Spears lowered
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares Ariippos #661 and Chrysope #3551 recognised each other's houses: guest-friends since a sale on the chain. 10 lived who would have died.

item.title: The stone in the Field of Ares is spent
item.description: 53 of the Sown were broken by their own brothers. House of Pelorus lost the fewest.

item.title: A rumour burns out
item.description: 11,503 Minyans heard it before it died: "They say the field at Deucalion's Strand ran with marrow. Some already call the dead a martyr. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it. The augurs say it was foretold."

item.title: A rumour burns out
item.description: 11,512 Minyans heard it before it died: "They say Hermmedes was cast out for a crime nobody will name. They say the Dodonaioi were behind it. The augurs say it was foretold."

item.title: Blood for blood
item.description: Philope #5749 the Avenger found Ersion #1727 the Blood-handed in the Field of Ares and settled the debt (the bones will knit; the shame will not).

item.title: A stone among the Sown in the Field of Ares
item.description: A token of the Sown sold on the chain for far below its worth: Ersion #5758 the Blood-handed, thrown into the Field of Ares like Jason's stone. The five houses have turned on each other.

item.title: Grain for Anthemoessa
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Pagasae brought 186 rations to hungry Anthemoessa.

item.title: The first remembrance of the freeing of Deucalion's Strand
item.description: 4502 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: A new helm for the Boule
item.description: The coalition is now Gorgonides + Anthemoessans + House of Chthonius + Gegeneis.

item.title: Archlaos is cast out
item.description: The ekklesia scratched Archlaos #1487 the Ostracized's name on bone shards. Sixty days of exile.

item.title: Revolt: Burning Lake of Eridanus throws off Field of Ares
item.description: Burning Lake of Eridanus throws off Field of Ares. The lord city will not let it go quietly.

item.title: Grain for Lemnos
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Pagasae brought 189 rations to hungry Lemnos.

item.title: A new song
item.description: Demkrates #8423 has put the breaking of the Poietai into verse. Sung things last.

item.title: A parent who forgot
item.description: Hippmachos #2001 the Twice-Born came back from the Meadow and did not know their own Leaf, Agathkrates Hippmachides ~645.

item.title: Votes for sale
item.description: Andrope #5697 bought 60 votes in Lemnos the night before the Boule.

item.title: Caught buying votes
item.description: The Lynceus caught Lyskles #8463 buying 60 votes in Lemnos.

item.title: Grain for Burning Lake of Eridanus
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Reef brought 53 rations to hungry Burning Lake of Eridanus.

item.title: Drained
item.description: Xenon Timstratides ~951's too-perfect lover was an Empusa. Only a husk was found.

item.title: Grain for Deucalion's Strand
item.description: Ships and mule-trains from Bear Mountain brought 273 rations to hungry Deucalion's Strand.

item.title: Blood for blood
item.description: Eurmenes #5770 the Avenger found Glaukon #870 the Blood-handed in the Field of Ares and settled the debt (the bones will knit; the shame will not).

item.title: A child for Nikion
item.description: Nikion #5172 the Twice-Born has sown their first Leaf: Eustrato Nichides ~2683. It will age; its parent will not.

item.title: A temple for the Silent Poietai
item.description: The Silent Poietai raised a house of stone for their god in the Field of Ares.

item.title: A temple for the True Theriodai of Field of Ares
item.description: The True Theriodai of Field of Ares raised a house of stone for their god in the Field of Ares.

item.title: A love ends at the Pyra
item.description: Klephon Theides ~14 and Phaidion #6731 loved for 125 days. Now one is ash and the other must learn to be alone.

item.title: The first remembrance of the calling of the Dodonaioi
item.description: 320 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: The Pagasaean Games
item.description: Hippos #233 won the foot-race at the Pagasaean Games. A truce holds while the games last.

item.title: The Mist-terraces closed
item.description: Quarantine in the Mist-terraces: 9 sick, the roads guarded, the caravans turned back.

item.title: Thrice broken, thrice risen
item.description: Dorkrates #9142 the Twice-Born has been broken three times now (plague). Each time the bones knit again. The Reapers have started to leave a little room by the gate.

item.title: The first remembrance of the stone in Field of Ares
item.description: 1622 Minyans kept the day.

item.title: A parent who forgot
item.description: Eurmenes #9404 the Twice-Born came back from the Meadow and did not know their own Leaf, Spartdoto Dorides ~2168.

item.title: An Empusa unmasked
item.description: Dion #2078 named the beautiful lover of Neoides Ersdorides ~614 for what it was. It went to dust.

item.title: A new song
item.description: Demkrates #8423 has put the breaking of the Burning Poietai into verse. Sung things last.

item.title: The sea's share
item.description: Astkrates #3342's ship came back from the Hyperboreans without 4 of its crew.

item.title: A house divided
item.description: Theo Peisphonides ~222 has split from the house of Peisphon #1493 and founded the house of Theos, taking 1 of the line.

item.title: A child for Demias
item.description: Demias #9132 the Twice-Born has sown their first Leaf: Neoeia Demides ~2643. It will age; its parent will not.

item.title: A parent who forgot
item.description: Philion #6360 the Twice-Born came back from the Meadow and did not know their own Leaf, Alkippo Lykides ~427.

item.title: The Pythia speaks
item.description: Agathias #9655 the Blood-handed asked the god and was told: "Wooden walls alone will stand, when the spears of the Field of Ares are counted."
